Cross-Platform Builds > Local Builds on Linux and Windows

Local Builds on Linux and Windows

Installing Zig 0.17.0

The version must be ≥ the minimum_zig_version = "0.17.0" in build.zig.zon. 0.17.0 is a development snapshot and the ziglang.org download page does not offer that version; CI uses mlugg/setup-zig pinned to 0.17.0, and locally you can get the same snapshot package from the machengine mirror. Note that the official package naming is zig-<arch>-<os>-<version> (arch first):

# Linux x86_64
curl -sL -o /tmp/zig.tar.xz \
  https://pkg.hexops.org/zig/0.17.0/zig-x86_64-linux-0.17.0.tar.xz
mkdir -p /opt/zig && tar -xf /tmp/zig.tar.xz -C /opt/zig --strip-components=1
ln -sf /opt/zig/zig /usr/local/bin/zig
zig version   # 应输出 0.17.0

Windows uses the corresponding zig-x86_64-windows-0.17.0.zip from the mirror, and macOS uses zig-aarch64-macos-0.17.0.tar.xz (Apple Silicon). CI is pinned to 0.17.0 (.github/workflows/ci.yml); before upgrading Zig, first confirm the full gate passes.

Native Linux Build (with the LLVM Backend)

Linux enables the LLVM-C backend by default and needs the LLVM 14 development files (matching CI's linux-full job):

# 运行目录：sci 仓库根目录
sudo apt-get install -y llvm-14-dev
zig build                  # 完整构建，产物在 zig-out/
zig build test             # 完整测试门禁（耗时较长，约 10 分钟以上）
zig build linux-runtime    # Linux 专属运行时门禁
zig build core             # 跨平台核心编译器检查（较快）

Without an LLVM environment you can use zig build -Dllvm=false to verify compilation quickly, but wasm-matrix and some plugin-host-smoke cases will fail with LLVM-C backend is disabled — that is an environment limitation, not a code problem.

Windows Build

# 运行目录：sci 仓库根目录
# Windows 本机（含 LLVM-C 后端，LLVM 14 路径按本机调整）
zig build -Dllvm=true -Dllvm-include-dir="C:\Program Files\LLVM\include" ^
  -Dllvm-lib-dir="C:\Program Files\LLVM\lib" -Dllvm-lib-name=LLVM-C

# Linux 主机交叉编译 Windows（无需 LLVM，用于验证可移植性）
zig build -Dtarget=x86_64-windows-gnu -Dllvm=false -p zig-out-windows

A known fix (already in main): Unix-domain-socket-related code (connectUnixSocket in daemon_client.zig, daemonCommand in cli.zig) could not compile for windows-gnu under Zig 0.17.0 and has been isolated with comptime branches — on Windows the daemon client returns null directly and the daemon server reports unsupported. New Unix socket logic must continue this pattern, otherwise the Windows cross build will fail.

Existing Verification Conclusions

  • zig build (Linux + LLVM 14): passes; zig-out/bin/sa is about 20M;
  • zig build core -Dllvm=false: passes;
  • zig build test -Dllvm=false: 361/365 pass; the 3 failures are all environmental (2 need the LLVM backend; 1 is because -p changed the output prefix so zig-out/lib was missing, and rerunning the default build restores it);
  • zig build sa-std-unit: passes.
